cc:Work.dc:title: Lossless installed MLX alpha: recorded exact-retention comparison
cc:Work.dc:description: Stock serial MLX: 574.8 milliseconds per batch. Lossless retained recipe: 295.4 milliseconds. Speedup 1.945x; descriptive 95% interval [1.933, 1.988]. All tested tokens, log-probability bits and active KV state match.
